messages.subject: Navigation button
parts:
Hi all, 

I've done some research on this topic but given my limited programming experience, I couldn't figure out how to incorporate a navigation button to jump between tabs in one Shiny app. Normally, we can use the navigation bar to go between tabs. However, I want to create some "hidden" tabs which cannot be accessed via navigation bar but only via a button in the "shown" tab. 

I have experimented with html anchor tag, but it can only refer within one tab. My guess is that I can write some js script to help, but I have no such knowledge. The closest thing I can find on the internet is the super zip example: http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/superzip-example.html. When you go to the "Data Explorer" tab and click on one of the action crosshair button, it will jump back to the map again. However, I cannot replicate this for my use due to restraint of knowledge. 

Thank you for your time.
